suppress.reason: A rule's test suite has to contain the pattern the rule matches. These six fire on the INPUTS the suites feed the analyzer — an AWS-shaped key, a weak hash, a bundled-package name, a TODO-authorization comment — and every one was verified against the source before being listed here. Rule IDs are named rather than wildcarded so a genuinely new finding in a test file still reports.

Research harnesses, not shipped code: they generate adversarial corpora and evaluation figures, so they quote payloads and weak primitives on purpose. scripts/ is absent from every published artifact — the CLI tarball is apps/cli only, and the extensions are bundled.
